decisions.reason: The trace-quotient lemma assumes nonempty boundary, so its unqualified attribution did not cover the empty open set. This is a citation-scope defect, not a failure of the quotient or DN map: both Sobolev spaces on the empty set are zero, and the existing fixed-atlas definition explicitly sets its empty-boundary space to zero. Split these cases without excluding any original admissible domain.

Step 4.1 used scalar-conductivity notation gamma|grad W|^2 for a matrix coefficient without declaring a quadratic-form convention. Its intended scalar energy expansion is valid by symmetry and the weak equation, so this is a notation defect, not a missing existence or boundedness argument. Replaced all three energies by (gamma grad w) dot grad w and retained the original estimate and bilinearity proof.

F1 overstated what the candidate definition itself establishes. The needed existence and uniqueness result was already stated in F2, listed in deps, and used explicitly in step 3.1, so this is an inaccurate fact attribution rather than an unsupported theorem. F1 now defines the candidate pairing conditionally and attributes well-posedness to F2.

reviews.reason: Checked the full quotient/energy candidate, AC and CC, symmetric ellipticity, and justified_by separation. A nonempty bounded open subset of Euclidean space has nonempty boundary, so the existing trace-quotient lemma applies there. For the empty set the Sobolev quotient and fixed-atlas boundary space are both zero; the energy is zero. Added the explicit empty-case convention supplier and preserved all hypotheses and claims.

Checked the exact Poincare, completeness and real Lax-Milgram hypotheses. The gradient norm is Hilbert on H1_0, the matrix form is bounded and coercive, and one lift yields a solution. Testing differences proves uniqueness and representative independence. Symmetry and the weak equation remove the energy cross term; infima over lifts yield ||grad u|| <= sqrt(C/c)||f|| and the stated bilinear bound. The empty set is the zero-space case. Corrected all matrix quadratic forms and kept the Statement unchanged.

Checked ellipticity of DF gamma DF^T/J, the H1 composition bounds, smooth-density extension of the chain and energy identities, and transport of the H1_0 weak tests. Equal L2 traces give equal quotient classes by the now-explicit trace-kernel supplier, and F2 supplies unique solutions. The inverse tensor and absolute-Jacobian density calculations prove the Riemannian energy identity without orientability; compactly supported tests prove harmonicity and bijectivity fixes zero-extended patch data. Corrected F1 attribution and AC/CC accounting. Statement unchanged.
